The raw NAF files were used only to verify that each operational graph matches
one Wikinews article and that the NAF files contain no manual annotation
layers. They are not copied into this package. Checksums of those 30 files are
in `../WIKINEWS/raw_naf_checksums.tsv`.

The 30 operational TextGraphs were generated by TextGraphX from the raw Wikinews articles and retained source-file metadata. No manual MEANTIME annotations were used to generate the TextGraphs or evaluate semantic projection in this study.

The original MEANTIME CC BY 4.0 licence file was retrieved from the annotated dataset archive and preserved unchanged in third_party/MEANTIME/LICENSE.txt. The annotated files are not redistributed. MEANTIME attribution applies to retained corpus-packaging metadata, while the source-bearing operational TextGraphs derive from Wikinews articles distributed under CC BY 2.5.

`document_manifest.tsv` already has columns for source title, source URL, publication date, Wikinews attribution, licence, and transformation description. No new columns were added.

Packaging fields that remain inside the operational graphs are listed in `document_manifest.tsv` (`meantime_metadata_used=yes`). `contains_meantime_annotation=no` for every operational graph in this study.
